title: Pehla shlok, ek dukh se
style: warm hand-drawn illustration, clean outlines, soft sunset light, expressive faces, traditional Indian devotional art, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Ramayan ka pehla shlok kaise bana?
summary: Ramayan Tathya 1/60: Tamasa kinare kraunch pakshi ka dukh, Ma Nishad pehla shlok, Brahma ji ki aagya (Valmiki Ramayan, Bal Kand, Sarga 2)

scenes.prompt: close-up portrait of Maharishi Valmiki, an elderly sage with a long white beard, saffron robes and rudraksha beads, eyes moist with compassion, on the bank of the Tamasa river at sunrise, soft golden light, no text
scenes.tts: क्या आप जानते हैं? रामायण का पहला श्लोक एक पक्षी के दुख से निकला!
scenes.sub: Kya aap jaante hain? Ramayan ka pehla shlok ek pakshi ke dukh se nikla!
scenes.animate: the river water ripples softly and the sage's white beard stirs gently in the morning breeze

scenes.prompt: a pair of krauncha cranes beside the Tamasa river in a calm forest at dawn, one crane looking up in sorrow as a single white feather drifts down, no blood, the sage Valmiki watching from the bank with folded hands, no text
scenes.tts: तमसा नदी के किनारे महर्षि वाल्मीकि ने एक दृश्य देखा। एक शिकारी ने क्रौंच पक्षियों के जोड़े में से एक को मार दिया।
scenes.sub: Tamasa nadi ke kinare Maharishi Valmiki ne ek drishya dekha. Ek shikari ne kraunch pakshiyon ke jode mein se ek ko maar diya.

scenes.prompt: Maharishi Valmiki with closed eyes and a tear on his cheek, one hand raised as a verse flows from his heart, a soft divine glow around him, Brahma ji on a pink lotus in the sky blessing him, no text
scenes.tts: उनका दुख एक श्लोक बनकर निकला, मा निषाद। फिर ब्रह्मा जी ने उन्हें इसी छंद में श्री राम की कथा लिखने को कहा।
scenes.sub: Unka dukh ek shlok bankar nikla, 'Ma Nishad', aur Brahma ji ne unhe isi chhand mein Shri Ram ki katha likhne ko kaha.

scenes.prompt: a closed bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with red thread on a carved wooden stand in a quiet forest hermitage, a small brass diya glowing beside it, warm light, no text, no letters, no writing
scenes.tts: यह प्रसंग वाल्मीकि रामायण के बालकांड में है।

scenes.prompt: Maharishi Valmiki seated in peaceful meditation under a banyan tree at golden hour, a pair of cranes flying freely in the sky above, hopeful mood, no text
scenes.tts: सच्ची करुणा से ही महान रचना जन्म लेती है।
scenes.sub: Sachchi karuna se hi mahaan rachna janm leti hai.
scenes.animate: the cranes glide slowly across the golden sky and the banyan leaves sway gently

scenes.tts: जय श्री राम! ऐसे ही रोचक तथ्य के लिए लाइक, शेयर और श्याम प्रेमी एसएन को सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Jai Shree Ram! Aise hi rochak tathya ke liye Like, Share aur Shyam Premi SN ko Subscribe karein.

facts.claim: By the Tamasa, Valmiki saw a hunter kill one of a pair of krauncha birds; his grief became the shloka 'Ma Nishad'; Brahma asked him to tell Rama's whole story in that metre.
